To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimal release time for the flexible model with a random life-cycle is always finite and unique, and it decreases with the increase in the penalty cost.

(i) there exists a finite unique release time, which minimizes the total cost of the system, subject to achieving the given level of performability; and (ii) the optimal release time increases as the penalty cost increases, and the optimal release time decreases as the penalty cost decreases.

(1) there is an optimal release time for the software, (2) the optimal release time depends on the parameters of the model and the penalty cost, and (3) the optimal release policy is to release the software at the optimal release time.
